teaser: The hum of a printer warming up, before anyone has arrived to use it, is the kind of sound that settles the day before anything in it starts. Life path 1 is the number of the one who leads, and ESTJ is the type built to run the room once the leading begins. Put the two in one person and the pairing is less about wanting to be first than about wanting the structure around first to hold. The drive to go it alone meets a mind that already knows how a plan should be organized, a deadline set, and credit assigned. Little daydreaming happens before the plan is already moving.
excerpt: The salon chair that locks a half-inch too high, no matter how many times you pull the lever, is where some of the longest conversations happen, because for once there is nowhere else to be.
